Careers at Wolwedans
At Wolwedans, our guests go slow and disconnect to reconnect
with themselves, with nature, and with humankind.
Watch full video
Our purpose is the Pursuit of Happiness, and Wolwedans exists to inspire a new way.
If you visit one place in Africa, make it Wolwedans.
Located in the heart of NamibRand Nature Reserve, Wolwedans is more than a collection of camps. It is a collection of dreams. Wolwedans is a sanctuary of space, silence, and soulful connection. Our collection of unique camps and lodges invites you to explore this extraordinary desert landscape, where rolling dunes meet endless horizons, and nature’s rhythm inspires true tranquility.
Wolwedans was born in 1995 from a dream shared by the late Albi Brückner and his son Stephan. What began with four humble igloo tents has evolved into an iconic collection of camps and an active Foundation.
Wolwedans will quietly continue to do its work, contributing in a meaningful way to the conservation of NamibRand, the development of Namibia and its communities, and driving Rural Revival, the building of a Desert-Based Economy.
By staying with us, you’ll contribute to meaningful conservation of the NamibRand, sustainable rural development, and the preservation of Namibia’s natural heritage. Here, we honor a philosophy of People | Planet | Profit – ensuring every visit helps secure a brighter future for the land, its wildlife, and its people.
Be our guest and become part of the change we all want to see.

Dune Camp
The original Wolwedans camp, Dune Camp sits atop a 250-metre dune with panoramic views across the desert. Intimate and full of character, it offers a laid-back yet stylish experience where canvas tents, shared dinners and unforgettable sunsets encourage guests to slow down and connect.
Explore more
Desert Lodge
Perched among rolling dunes with sweeping views of the NamibRand, Desert Lodge offers a timeless desert escape. Spacious tented suites, expansive decks and inviting shared spaces create a relaxed atmosphere where exceptional hospitality and the ever-changing desert landscape take centre stage.
Explore more
Plains Camp
Hidden in a secluded valley, Plains Camp is an exclusive-use villa designed for families and groups seeking privacy and space. Surrounded by vast desert plains, it combines generous indoor and outdoor living areas with a private guide and chef for a completely personalised desert escape.
Explore more
Mountain View Suite
Designed for complete privacy, Mountain View Suite is Wolwedans' most exclusive and romantic retreat. Overlooking an endless valley of dunes and distant mountains, it includes a private guide, chef and vehicle, allowing guests to experience the Namib at their own pace in complete seclusion.
Explore more
Boulders Camp
At the base of a rocky outcrop, with massive rock mountains towering behind, Boulders Camp looks out over an endless landscape of gravel plains, dotted with the tops of submerged mountains.
Explore more
Since its inception, Wolwedans has been guided by an approach where people, planet and profit are all equally important. Our long term goal is to ensure the conservation of the Pro-Namib for future generations.
Wolwedans is more than a collection of camps. It's a collection of dreams. Its ethos lies in setting an example in sustainability and continually fulfilling its commitment to the conservation of the NamibRand Nature Reserve.

Our Camps and Lodges
Wolwedans sits deep inside the 220,000 hectare NamibRand Nature Reserve, one of the largest private reserves in southern Africa.
Find your place in the desert with the Wolwedans Collection of camps and lodges.
Whoever you re travelling with, there s a camp built around you. Couples wanting total privacy, families ready to roam, friends after a place that s entirely theirs for a few days. Each camp is built to blend into its surroundings, celebrating the landscape rather than competing with it.
Choose Desert Lodge, Dune Camp, Boulders Camp, Plains Camp, or the Mountain View Suite: five very different homes, each with its own stretch of the NamibRand Nature Reserve to call its own.
Wolwedans wants guests to go slow,
and disconnect to reconnect
with themselves, with nature, and with humankind
Stephan Brückner
Dune Camp
Dune Camp is situated on the site where the first four Wolwedans Igloo Dome tents were built, back in the late 90s.  It s a special place for us and carries many memories. Today, the Igloos are long gone, but we ve tried to preserve the spirit of this down-to-earth experience while still delivering comfort and style.
Desert Lodge
Desert Lodge is positioned in one of the most enviable locations that the NamibRand has to offer and has a stunning outlook over orange-hued dunes and craggy mountains. This magnificent vista is at the heart of the lodge, and all the rooms and guest areas are perfectly positioned to make the most of the incredible surroundings.
Mountain View Suite
The Mountain View Suite is built over 200 square metres of deck above the dunes. It is exclusive, romantic and extraordinary, with ample space to relax while staring down the valley to the distant mountains one of the most magnificent views in the reserve.
Plains Camp
Plains Camp , formerly known as Private Camp, is our exclusive villa, resting in the centre of a vast valley and surrounded by plains for as far as the eye can see. Plains Camp is your special home at Wolwedans, demanding nothing of you but to relax and gaze at the ever-changing colours of the desert
Boulders Camp
Boulders Camp is located in and around the base of a massive outcrop of granite rocks in the NamibRand plains. This tiny camp is 3 hours south of our other camps and as far off the beaten track as you can get. This is the place for adventure and to enjoy being completely removed from every day life.

Desert Lodge
Where views, comfort and warm Namibian hospitality combine.
Positioned in one of the most enviable locations that the NamibRand has to offer, Desert Lodge has a stunning outlook. Think vast orange-hued dunes, mountains, rolling skies and, well, nothing. This magnificent vista is at the heart of the lodge, and all the rooms and guest areas are perfectly positioned to make the most of the surroundings. The lodge has recently been refreshed with new furnishings, layered textures and handcrafted details, carrying a design language guided by one simple idea: Of the Earth.
The lodge reflects the ambience of a tented camp but provides the comfort and protection of a permanent building. After a day out on the reserve, it s the perfect place to return to, whether that s settling into the main areas to connect with fellow guests, or finding a quiet corner of your own to sink into the Wolwedans Way.
Quick Facts
RATES: From NAD 14 900 per person per night (excludes the per person per night Sustainability Levy )
STAY: Minimum 2 night stay required
SEASONALITY: Open all year
CHILDREN: 5 + years
WATCH THE DESERT LODGE VIDEO
Tented Rooms
The 10 tented rooms, including 3 Family Rooms, are open to the beautiful desert vistas and have been built to maximise the views from all corners of the room. Each has a private verandah, connecting you to the swathes of untouched sand beyond, and new wooden walkways now link every room to the main area. All rooms have a new King/Twin bed configuration, and the Family Rooms have gained two additional single beds for children aged 5 to 14. Each room also has its own Wolwedans Chiller and Wi-Fi. We highly recommend sleeping with your canvas blinds open to feel the soft evening breeze and marvel at the vast star-studded sky.
The Lodge
Arriving at Desert Lodge, you re welcomed into a friendly reception area, the first taste of the warmth that runs through the whole lodge. From there, the main areas unfold across a series of decks atop the sand, giving guests plenty of choice in how they spend their time.
A spacious main lounge is ideal for gathering with fellow travellers, while a smaller lounge offers a quieter spot to relax. There s also a spacious bar, perfect for a sundowner, and a fire pit out on the deck overlooking the sand, a lovely spot to end the day. Beyond that, multiple areas for you to dine and relax mean there s always a space to suit whatever you re in the mood for.

Mountain View Suite
Your Private Desert Sanctuary
The Mountain View Suite is located within walking distance from Desert Lodge, but feels as if you are in your own private universe. The Suite is orientated to enjoy an expansive view down the valley to the mountains in the distance, and has recently been refreshed with interiors that carry the same warmth and craftsmanship found across the rest of the collection. Consisting of a spacious en-suite bedroom leading onto a pool deck, the space enables guests to enjoy the view of the valley to its fullest.
A shaded patio provides an ideal venue for meals and relaxed hours on the deck. Add to this a spacious lounge and kitchen, and you have a wonderful home away from home. The suite comes with its own chef, guide and vehicle.
Quick Facts
RATES: from NAD 17 800 per night for the entire Suite (excludes the per-person per-night Sustainability Levy )
STAY: Minimum 2-night stay required
SEASONALITY: Open all year
CHILDREN: 18+ years
Your Suite
This suite offers one en-suite bedroom (up to 2 adults), and a private lounge, dining area and fire pit, plus an outside bathroom, a sleep-out deck and a plunge pool. The main veranda has a star-gazing bed, a wonderful spot to sleep out under the stars during summer.
Keeping in line with the recently refreshed Wolwedans style, the ambience is one of plain elegance embraced by a natural, comfortable charm, with handcrafted details and warm, earthy tones running through every corner of the suite.
Experiences
The choice is yours as to how much or how little you would like to do. Mountain View Suite has its own private guide and vehicle, so you set the itinerary.
Activities included:  Morning and evening scenic drives | Wolwedans Desert Sundowners | Heart and Home village tour | Full-day scenic safari | Bushman walk | E-biking | Solitude Moments
Additional cost, to be booked:  Hot air ballooning | Horse-riding | Spa & Wellness | Desert Sleep-Out and Star Beds
